title: Buddha's Beef Delight
description: A Chinese-inspired beef stir-fry with delicate flavors and textures. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
Add the ginger to the wok and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetables to the wok and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the beef to the wok and stir in the soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the beef is coated in the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
